sloka: तस्यैव तपसो व्युष्ट्या प्रसादाच्च स्वयम्भुवः।नासुरेभ्यो न देवेभ्यो भयं मम कदाचन ।। ६.९३.२९ ।।
transliteration: tasyaiva tapaso vyuṣṭyā prasādācca svayambhuvaḥ।nāsurebhyo na devebhyo bhayaṁ mama kadācana ।। 6.93.29 ।।

translations.english: 'By the power of the penancedone by me once, creator Brahma has given me reward, pleased with my penance. I have no fear of Asuras or Devas'.
